## Context
RP-01 S5 (ripening-liberal-tuatara, 10a3-7dd0-1b3d-47cc) made the one-operation Pydantic structured-output path authoritative. Its AC-6 is [operator-attested]: direct Anthropic and Bedrock same-run retry/cache canaries. That AC could NOT be executed in the autonomous implementation session because live provider credentials (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + AWS) were absent. S5 was closed with an honest, transparent --force override; the retry-layer and cache-accounting contract is meanwhile pinned by the offline AC-1/3/4 oracle and documented (AC-8). This ticket tracks running the live canaries when a credentialed operator is available.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] [operator-attested] Direct Anthropic canary: a live structured run over the authoritative one-operation path succeeds with a typed result; the ticket records timestamp, model id, request count, cache read/write/input counts, and the complete-vs-omit branch; no secret appears in output or artifacts.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Direct Bedrock canary: same, over Bedrock.
- [ ] Observed cache read/write/input accounting matches the documented contract in docs/llm-framework.md; any divergence is filed as a follow-up.

## Testing
- Run the canaries with environment-provided credentials; do not print or persist secrets.
- Cross-check the observed counts against docs/llm-framework.md's retry/accounting section.
